result.description: A fictional high-capacity network-attached archive vault designed for long-term cold storage, the Nocturne Arc combines mirrored solid-state caching with an energy-sipping retention controller and remote snapshot scheduling. It is intended for studios, labs, and small offices that need quiet always-on storage rather than portable flash media. Features include dual 2.5GbE ports, encrypted at-rest file containers, automated integrity scrubbing, and a front-panel e-ink status strip.
result.title: Nocturne Arc 5TB Network Archive Vault
